misprints.note: No breathing on alpha in the print, though the next word ἀσπίδος has one.
Printed with epsilon, but the same entry has σηρικοδιαστής.
Genitive ending printed without breathing. This is normal for endings and is kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The mark over the iota is a rough breathing with a stray stroke, possibly broken type. Read as αἱ, not αἵ.
The accent over ει is blurred, so it could be εἴς or εἲς. Kept εἴς.
The mark over the upsilon looks like a rough breathing that could be mistaken for an acute. Read as αὑτῷ.
